d:
Pradhanmantri narendr modi ne manch se mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ko khas andaj men aashirvad diya. vahin piem modi ne nitish kumar ki bhi jamkar tariph ki aur unke yogdan ko saraha. dekhie piem modi ke sanbodhan ka yah khas pal, jab manch se dikha bihar ki siyasat ka khas sandesh
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
